SUMMARY "Bodyweight Strength Foundations (12 Weeks) + Nutrition + Home Cardio + Mobility"

PHASE 1: Fundamentals (Weeks 1-4)
- Strength: 3x/week full body (push_up, inverted_row, squat, plank, incline_press, pull_up, lunge, hollow_hold, glute_bridge, side_plank)
- Cardio: 2x/week (jump_rope, high_knees, mountain_climber, butt_kicks)
- Finisher: 1x/week (burpee, mountain_climber, squat_jump, plank_up)
- Mobility: 1x/week (cat_cow, hip_circles, ankle_circles, spinal_twist, pigeon_pose, frog_stretch, butterfly_stretch, forward_fold, diaphragmatic_breathing)
- Progression: Gradual increase in reps, sets, and time under tension

PHASE 2: Progression (Weeks 5-8)
- Strength: 3x/week full body, higher intensity (more sets, higher RPE, shorter rest)
- Cardio: 2x/week, increased volume (more rounds, higher RPE)
- Finisher: 1x/week (AMRAP and challenge circuits)
- Mobility: 1x/week, same flow as Phase 1
- Progression: More sets (up to 6), higher reps, more challenging finishers

PHASE 3: Challenge & Consolidate (Weeks 9-12)
- Strength: 3x/week full body, peak volume and intensity
- Cardio: 2x/week, maintain high volume/intensity
- Finisher: 1x/week (mixed bodyweight circuits, higher reps/time)
- Mobility: 1x/week, maintain flow
- Progression: Maximal reps, AMRAP, and advanced bodyweight circuits

NUTRITION
- Slight calorie surplus (250-350 kcal above maintenance)
- Protein: 1.6-2.2g/kg bodyweight daily
- Carbs: Emphasize whole grains, fruits, vegetables
- Fats: Prioritize healthy fats
- Hydration: 2L+ water daily
- 3-4 balanced meals/day, protein in each meal, post-workout meal within 2h
- Minimize processed foods, adjust calories based on weight change
- Optional supplements: protein_powder, creatine, vitamin_d, omega_3

EQUIPMENT RECOMMENDATIONS
- High: adjustable_dumbbells (up to 20-25kg each), resistance_bands (light/medium/heavy)
- Medium: kettlebell (12-20kg), dip_bars/parallettes
- Optional: weight_vest (10-20kg), sturdy pull_up_bar, yoga_mat, foam_roller

WEEKLY STRUCTURE (all 12 weeks)
- Monday: Full Body Strength A
- Tuesday: Home Cardio A
- Wednesday: Full Body Strength B
- Thursday: Home Cardio B
- Friday: Full Body Strength C
- Saturday: Fun Finisher (challenge/AMRAP/circuit)
- Sunday: Mobility Flow

PROGRESSION
- Weeks 1-4: Build base, learn movement, increase reps/sets gradually
- Weeks 5-8: Push intensity, more sets/reps, shorter rest, higher RPE
- Weeks 9-12: Maximal effort, AMRAP, advanced circuits, consolidate gains

NOTES
- All sessions can be performed in a small flat with a mat and pull-up bar
- Cardio and finishers use only bodyweight and minimal space
- Mobility routine supports recovery and flexibility
- Nutrition and equipment guidance included for long-term progress

SUMMARY "Bodyweight Strength Foundations (12 Weeks) + Nutrition + Home Cardio + Mobility"

PHASE 1: Fundamentals (Weeks 1-4)
- Strength: 3x/week full body (push_up, inverted_row, squat, plank, incline_press, pull_up, lunge, hollow_hold, glute_bridge, side_plank)
- Cardio: 2x/week (jump_rope, high_knees, mountain_climber, butt_kicks)
- Finisher: 1x/week (burpee, mountain_climber, squat_jump, plank_up)
- Mobility: 1x/week (cat_cow, hip_circles, ankle_circles, spinal_twist, pigeon_pose, frog_stretch, butterfly_stretch, forward_fold, diaphragmatic_breathing)
- Progression: Gradual increase in reps, sets, and time under tension

PHASE 2: Progression (Weeks 5-8)
- Strength: 3x/week full body, higher intensity (more sets, higher RPE, shorter rest)
- Cardio: 2x/week, increased volume (more rounds, higher RPE)
- Finisher: 1x/week (AMRAP and challenge circuits)
- Mobility: 1x/week, same flow as Phase 1
- Progression: More sets (up to 6), higher reps, more challenging finishers

PHASE 3: Challenge & Consolidate (Weeks 9-12)
- Strength: 3x/week full body, peak volume and intensity
- Cardio: 2x/week, maintain high volume/intensity
- Finisher: 1x/week (mixed bodyweight circuits, higher reps/time)
- Mobility: 1x/week, maintain flow
- Progression: Maximal reps, AMRAP, and advanced bodyweight circuits

NUTRITION
- Slight calorie surplus (250-350 kcal above maintenance)
- Protein: 1.6-2.2g/kg bodyweight daily
- Carbs: Emphasize whole grains, fruits, vegetables
- Fats: Prioritize healthy fats
- Hydration: 2L+ water daily
- 3-4 balanced meals/day, protein in each meal, post-workout meal within 2h
- Minimize processed foods, adjust calories based on weight change
- Optional supplements: protein_powder, creatine, vitamin_d, omega_3

EQUIPMENT RECOMMENDATIONS
- High: adjustable_dumbbells (up to 20-25kg each), resistance_bands (light/medium/heavy)
- Medium: kettlebell (12-20kg), dip_bars/parallettes
- Optional: weight_vest (10-20kg), sturdy pull_up_bar, yoga_mat, foam_roller

WEEKLY STRUCTURE (all 12 weeks)
- Monday: Full Body Strength A
- Tuesday: Home Cardio A
- Wednesday: Full Body Strength B
- Thursday: Home Cardio B
- Friday: Full Body Strength C
- Saturday: Fun Finisher (challenge/AMRAP/circuit)
- Sunday: Mobility Flow

PROGRESSION
- Weeks 1-4: Build base, learn movement, increase reps/sets gradually
- Weeks 5-8: Push intensity, more sets/reps, shorter rest, higher RPE
- Weeks 9-12: Maximal effort, AMRAP, advanced circuits, consolidate gains

NOTES
- All sessions can be performed in a small flat with a mat and pull-up bar
- Cardio and finishers use only bodyweight and minimal space
- Mobility routine supports recovery and flexibility
- Nutrition and equipment guidance included for long-term progress
